privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.who_text: Kulturveko i Os is the data controller for personal data collected through this website. The festival is organized in Os, Bjørnafjorden municipality, Norway.
privacy.what_text: We only collect your email address when you sign up for our waitlist. We do not collect names, addresses, or other personal information.
privacy.why_text: Your email address is used to send you information about Kulturveko i Os, including program announcements, ticket sales, and festival news. The legal basis is consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)). You can withdraw your consent at any time.
privacy.processor_text: We use Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) as our data processor for email distribution. Brevo is an EU-based company and complies with GDPR. Your data is stored on servers within the EU.
privacy.rights_text: You have the right to access, rectify, delete, and port your data. You can also file a complaint with the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet). To exercise your rights, contact us at post@kulturveko.no.
privacy.contact_text: Questions about privacy can be directed to post@kulturveko.no.

terms.liability_text: We strive to ensure that the information on this website is accurate, but cannot guarantee that all content is up to date at all times. Kulturveko i Os is not liable for any errors or omissions.
terms.changes_text: We may change these terms at any time. Changes take effect when published on this page.
